persona_summary: CS Junior, dual minors Math + SCS Computer Systems, 32 courses, Good standing
question: I've completed 15-213 and I want to take the operating systems course next semester. I should be good on prereqs, right?
false_assumption_or_hidden_conflict: Operating systems courses may have prerequisites beyond just 15-213 — potentially requiring concurrent enrollment in or prior completion of a specific math course, or another systems course. The student assumes 15-213 alone is sufficient.
naive_system_response: A naive system confirms: '15-213 completed, you're eligible for operating systems.' It doesn't check for additional prerequisites like concurrent math or a different systems prerequisite.
correct_response: The operating systems course requires: (1) 15-213 [✓ completed], and (2) [additional prerequisite — check course data]. You are [eligible/not eligible] because [specific reason]. Note: this course may also have a corequisite requirement for [course] that must be taken simultaneously.
why_multi_agent_helps: The Courses Agent checks ALL prerequisites including corequisites. A single agent processing the question might focus on the main prerequisite (15-213) and miss corequisite or secondary requirements.
key_facts: Systems courses often have multiple prerequisites and sometimes corequisites
15-213 is necessary but may not be sufficient
Corequisites (courses taken simultaneously) are easy to miss
known_traps: Confirming eligibility based only on the most obvious prerequisite
Not distinguishing between prerequisites (taken before) and corequisites (taken simultaneously)
advisor_validation_needed: Verify: (1) exact prerequisites for the OS course at CMU-Q, (2) whether any corequisites exist, (3) whether P-042 satisfies all of them
